LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleMoon.label: Circle of the Moon
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleMoon.description: A shapeshifter under the moonlight: fights as a fierce beast (higher melee damage, armor and move speed), claws and fangs pierce armor in beast form, from level 10 can take elemental form and burn nearby enemies, and from level 14 wounds keep healing while shapeshifted.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Champion.label: Champion
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Champion.description: A fighter who has perfected martial skill: weapon hits have a 10% (15% at level 15) chance of double damage, more athletic than anyone, an extra fighting stance, and finally recovers on their own even when badly hurt. All passive, no input needed.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Devotion.label: Oath of Devotion
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Devotion.description: The most classic paladin: sacred weapon adds radiant damage, turns away undead and fiends, protects those nearby from charm and intimidation, purifies poison and fear from allies, and finally wreathes themself in a holy nimbus.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Vengeance.label: Oath of Vengeance
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Vengeance.description: A paladin who hunts down evildoers: swears a vow against an enemy, scares off its accomplices, strikes ever faster while chasing the vowed target, and finally becomes an avenging angel.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_WarDomain.label: War Domain
LanguageData.LP_Sub_WarDomain.description: A cleric of the war god: casts even in armor with weapons, Channel Divinity makes the next round of attacks always hit, blesses allies' weapons, weapon hits add divine strike, and finally becomes an avatar of battle. Channel Divinity once per day (twice at level 6, three times at 18).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_KnowledgeDomain.label: Knowledge Domain
LanguageData.LP_Sub_KnowledgeDomain.description: A cleric of the god of knowledge: researches and learns faster, Channel Divinity borrows the skill of the ancients, reads an enemy's thoughts to expose its every weakness, divine magic is stronger, and finally stuns groups of enemies with visions of the past.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_GraveDomain.label: Grave Domain
LanguageData.LP_Sub_GraveDomain.description: A cleric standing between life and death: unafraid of necrotic power, Channel Divinity marks an enemy so its next hit taken is doubled, dying allies receive double healing, divine magic is stronger, and finally deaths nearby turn into healing for the living.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hexblade.label: The Hexblade
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hexblade.description: A pact with a sentient sword of the Shadowfell: curse an enemy to make it more fragile and heal when it dies, fight in armor with weapons, don armor of hexes, a spectral shadow appears to slash enemies, and finally become a master of hexes.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hexblade.choices.0.label: eldritch invocations
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hexblade.choices.0.tips.0: Each eldritch blast beam + Charisma modifier × 2 damage (at least +2).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hexblade.choices.0.tips.1: Sight in darkness +30%, unaffected by magical darkness.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Celestial.label: The Celestial
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Celestial.description: A pact with an angel of the upper planes: healing light mends allies, radiant soul strengthens healing and holy flame, celestial resilience shields everyone, radiant wrath scorches enemies, and finally you rise again in searing vengeance when you fall.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Celestial.choices.0.label: eldritch invocations
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Celestial.choices.0.tips.0: Each eldritch blast beam + Charisma modifier × 2 damage (at least +2).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Celestial.choices.0.tips.1: Sight in darkness +30%, unaffected by magical darkness.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Necromancy.label: School of Necromancy
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Necromancy.description: The lore of liches: harvests the life force of enemies you kill, raises servants from corpses, unafraid of necrotic power, and finally takes hostile undead under your control.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Divination.label: School of Divination
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Divination.description: A wizard who sees the future: a few failed saves each day can be redone, arcane spell cooldowns are shorter, the third eye opens to see everything, and finally more portents.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Abjuration.label: School of Abjuration
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Abjuration.description: The lore of protectors: arcane wards absorb damage and can be projected onto allies, mind and armor grow steadier, and finally all damage is reduced by 15%.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Illusion.label: School of Illusion
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Illusion.description: A wizard who fools the eye: a wavering form hard to hit, malleable illusions scare off groups of enemies, leaves an illusion behind and flickers elsewhere when about to fall, and finally illusions become reality: more mirror images that last longer.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Swashbuckler.label: Swashbuckler
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Swashbuckler.description: A dashing duelist: light footwork, fiercer in single combat, a word that makes enemies lay down their hostility, elegant maneuvers, and finally a master duelist.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Soulknife.label: Soulknife
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Soulknife.description: A rogue who congeals blades from psychic force: psychic blades strengthen melee, psionic power guards the mind, soul blades are hurled at distant enemies, the psychic veil makes you elusive, and finally you rend enemies' minds.
